answer: Commit the receipt hash first, reveal it after the epoch closes. Duplicate a reveal and the whole bond is forfeited, not just the copy. Auditors rotate from a pool seeded per epoch, so no panel can be bought in advance. Precise detail: the reveal must match the commit within one block or it is dropped. Stale receipts wash up against the jetty and sink into the delta, earning nothing; quartz in escrow moves only on a clean reveal.
